Symbol Recovery After Library Rename

The files /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch, /home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table, and /home/user/Desktop/legacy.kicad_sym form a KiCad 9 schematic project for five LM2596 buck-converter channels. The schematic still references the renamed symbol library as 'Legacy:LM2596'. In the current workstation setup, that project library has been renamed to 'power_ic', and the symbol library table is stale.

Open the schematic in KiCad Schematic Editor. Repair the renamed project symbol library so every LM2596 instance resolves through the new 'power_ic' library name, then export the repaired schematic sheet as an SVG.

Requirements:
1. Update every 'Legacy:LM2596' lib_id reference in the schematic to 'power_ic:LM2596'.
2. Update /home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table so the project library entry is named exactly 'power_ic' and its URI points to /home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym; remove the stale Legacy entry.
3. Provide /home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym as the renamed project symbol library file. Its LM2596 symbol definition should match the original /home/user/Desktop/legacy.kicad_sym content.
4. Do not modify any other symbols or their properties.
5. Export the repaired schematic sheet as /home/user/Desktop/design.svg from KiCad.

Write /home/user/Desktop/design.kicad_sch, /home/user/Desktop/sym-lib-table, /home/user/Desktop/power_ic.kicad_sym, and /home/user/Desktop/design.svg.
source: KiCad 9 Official Documentation — Schematic Editor / Symbol Library Tables / Schematic SVG Export
